caption: The drawing depicts a single figure of a man standing upright on a round wooden platform. He is dressed in a formal, dark blue military-style uniform that includes a coat with gold shoulder epaulettes, gold buttons arranged in two vertical rows, and a gold sash around his waist. He is wearing matching blue trousers and black shoes. The man has a stern facial expression and wears a black bicorne hat decorated with gold trim on the side. He holds a telescope or spyglass, which is partly covered with a yellow cloth or tassel, in his left hand, while his right hand grasps his left wrist. The background is plain and off-white, giving full focus to the figure and the small section of the wooden platform on which he stands. The overall composition centers the man, who occupies most of the visual space.
title: Carved Figure
